I told Pree in a reply under their question in #central-team that the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is settled at 87 seats. Hollis first posted 268 on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same day because they'd read the wrong line. I told Pree to put 87 in the tracker.

Pree is a member of #central-team, so both of Hollis's messages were already visible to them. Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so this didn't need approval.
